description: Dividend spotlight: the "your week" card and the countdown to the next review on Home (GET /api/market/me/dividend-week), and the Dividends tab of the leaderboard (GET /api/leaderboard/dividends, /me and /players/:id). Reads the payouts every review already records, so past weeks show as soon as it turns on. Its oshi protection figures stay behind the oshi-protection flag.
